$comment: Applied output of the video-producer agent. One Reel per client per month per CLAUDE.md §9. Aditi's Kitchen May 2026 Reel: a dosa coming together on the tava — the most viewable food-process moment for this restaurant. Image-to-video via FAL.AI Kling 3.0 standard tier 5s, ~$0.50. Canonical negative_prompt from kling-image-to-video-prompt skill.

photo_selection.$comment: video-producer scores monthly_intakes.photo_urls. Aditi's intake for May should include several tava + dosa close-ups. Selection criteria: dosa visible mid-cook (golden crust forming, not fully plated), tava texture visible, hand of the cook in frame (acceptable — process not finished-plate), natural light, portrait or near-square aspect for 9:16 Reel framing.
photo_selection.selected_photo_url: TODO: operator picks dosa close-up from monthly_intake (prefer tava-with-dosa-spreading shot over finished-plated shot — process Reels outperform plate Reels for this kitchen)
photo_selection.selection_notes: If 0 acceptable photos in intake, skip the Reel for May and refund the slot to June. Do NOT submit a placeholder image — burns the FAL.AI $0.50 with no usable output. Backup subject if dosa photos are weak: parippuvada coming out of the karahi (also process, also Kerala-specific).

fal_job_spec.prompt: Subtle steam rising from the dosa on the tava. Gentle ghee shimmer on the crust where it meets the heat. Camera holds still. Natural daylight. No zoom.
fal_job_spec.negative_prompt: extra fingers, distorted hands, melting, AI artifacts, fast zoom, color shift, neon, sparkles, glitter, glow, blur, fish-eye, rotating, extra plates, extra dishes, morphing, magical effects, fake bokeh, warping, oversaturation, motion blur on subject

captions_and_overlay.ig_caption: A dosa on the tava. Two minutes start to plate. Tue–Sun · 11am–9pm · Ashburn
captions_and_overlay.music_mood: warm-acoustic-no-bass-drop — operator picks from IG's licensed library at upload time; avoid 'desi-trend' sounds that age the Reel within a week

cost_tracking.operator_approval_required_for: 10s tier (~$1.00) — skip unless festival peak week (Onam, Diwali). May is Akshaya Tritiya, not peak enough for 10s.

failure_path: If Kling output has visible artifacts (extra fingers on the cook's hand, melting dosa edge, color shift on the tava) on 2 consecutive submissions: pick a different source photo, re-submit once more, then skip for the month if still bad. Do not paper over with creative editing — the audience reads AI-slop instantly.
